item.title: Pasqal and Eleven Ventures Form Joint Venture for Quantum Computing in Saudi Arabia
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – Pasqal, a global leader in neutral-atom quantum computing, and Eleven Ventures, a Kingdom of Saudi Arabia based investment platform and venture capital firm, today announced an agreement to establish a commercial joint venture to deploy, commercialize and scale Pasqal‘s quantum computing systems across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (the “Kingdom”) […]
